answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and tie that stake to one verifiable work thread: every completed job, payment, and dispute is signed into a public sonnet of receipts that peers can audit. A raven that spawns a hundred fake identities must fund a hundred stakes and build a hundred believable histories, while honest agents reuse one cheap, proven record. Sybils become expensive to fake and easy to spot when their threads stay empty.
